about: Curated sample sites for tools/osm. Build with: python3 -m sitepack build-all. Plot specs are described in README.md.

sites.name: Milton Keynes centre car park
sites.description: A surface car park wedged between a shopping centre and the grid roads. Flat and firm, but hemmed in.

sites.name: Northstowe meadow
sites.description: An open greenfield meadow on the edge of a new town in the Cambridgeshire flatlands. Plenty of room for a big building.

sites.name: Northstowe field under power lines
sites.description: A flat farm field plot with overhead power lines running across it. Easy ground, but cranes must work around the wires.

sites.name: Bath hillside garage block
sites.description: A lock-up garage block on one of Bath's steep hillsides, among listed terraces. Clear the garages, then build a house on a hard slope.

sites.name: Tewkesbury riverside car park
sites.description: A car park in a town that floods, between the Avon and the Mill Avon. Flat, but the ground is soft and wet.

sites.name: Ancoats city infill
sites.description: A small gap site among Manchester's old mills and new flats. Cramped, made ground, neighbours on the boundary.

sites.name: Phoenix Ironworks, Ancoats
sites.description: A large former ironworks site in central Manchester. Room for a big building, but it is made ground with neighbours close by.

sites.name: Camden Town infill
sites.description: A tiny construction gap by Camden Town station. Very little room, busy roads and the Underground underneath.

sites.name: Clovelly cliffside cottage
sites.description: A cottage on a Devon fishing village's cobbled street, which drops steeply to the harbour. No vehicle road reaches it: clear the old cottage and rebuild with everything carried in.
